text: In response to concerns raised by residents regarding limited parking availability on Kippendavie Avenue, my office has received a petition from community members requesting changes to the current parking regulations. Specifically, residents are asking that parking on the west side of Kippendavie Avenue, between Queen Street and Kewbeach Avenue, be limited to a maximum of one hour. On-street permit parking holders would remain exempt from the one-hour limit.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking for a maximum period of one hour, on the west side of Kippendavie Avenue, at all times, between a point 131.1 metres south of Queen Street East and Kewbeach Avenue.
